description: Original UULAB starting directions. Non-verified option library, not a license to copy other interfaces.

directions.title: Proof-led editorial
directions.signature: Make the true product evidence the visual centre, with publication-like narrative rhythm.
directions.composition: Large proof image or demonstration followed by claim-and-evidence chapters
directions.typography: Expressive heading paired with exceptionally readable body text
directions.color: Restrained neutral foundations with one decision-bearing accent
directions.imagery: Owned product photography, process details, named captions
directions.motion: Subtle scroll reveal only when it helps comprehension

directions.title: Material-led storefront
directions.signature: Show what is sold through texture, dimensions and concrete proof rather than marketing gloss.
directions.composition: Product-led first viewport, specification-led comparison, then delivery and purchase reassurance
directions.typography: Confident product naming with systematic price and measurement labels
directions.color: Warm substrate from the actual material, contrasting purchase action
directions.imagery: Original product photos, scale references, consistent crops
directions.motion: Considered transitions for variant selection and zoom

directions.title: Decision workbench
directions.signature: Give data, filters and the next decision the hierarchy normally spent on decoration.
directions.composition: Context toolbar, primary working table or chart, right-sized detail inspection
directions.typography: Legible compact UI with tabular numerals where appropriate
directions.color: Quiet surfaces with semantic alert and selection colors
directions.imagery: Real product diagrams and meaningful sparklines, not decorative illustrations

directions.title: Living archive
directions.signature: Make discovery feel like navigating a considered catalogue with strong orientation.
directions.composition: Search-first index, editorial feature, collection-led discovery
directions.typography: Strong information hierarchy, clear category metadata and long-form readability
directions.imagery: Attributable archival imagery or original imagery with recorded licensing

directions.title: Focused conversion
directions.signature: Turn a precise promise into one obvious next action, backed by verifiable evidence.
directions.composition: Outcome and proof above the fold, objection-handling sequence, decisive CTA
directions.typography: Direct high-impact statement with short supporting lines
directions.color: Single primary action accent against accessible neutral grounds
directions.imagery: Real use-case screenshots and explained results
directions.motion: Only where it clarifies demonstration or interaction

directions.title: Calm operations
directions.signature: Treat the screen as a working instrument: high signal, deliberate density, reliable feedback.
directions.composition: Adaptive workspace shell, scoped filters, focused detail and clear actions
directions.typography: Compact system-friendly type, reliable text scaling and tabular amounts
directions.color: Neutral planes with stateful semantic colors
directions.imagery: Functional icons and actual data views
directions.motion: Fast transitions that preserve user context

directions.title: One-task utility
directions.signature: The user's main input and result are the hero; everything else is contextual.
directions.composition: Primary task first, contextual options second, history/reuse last
directions.typography: Large result, quiet supporting labels and accessible controls
directions.color: High contrast for active input, restrained supporting surfaces
directions.motion: Immediate feedback with a reduced-motion path

directions.title: Tactile journal
directions.signature: Make personal entries intimate and readable without making editing slower.
directions.composition: Entry content leads, expressive calendar or timeline, quiet edit surfaces
directions.typography: Comfortable long-form reading and differentiated date hierarchy
directions.color: Warm intentional surfaces with clear editable focus
directions.motion: Natural navigation with interrupt-safe save feedback

directions.title: Evidence console
directions.signature: Deliver crisp, precise analytics that remain actionable on a phone.
directions.composition: Scope and time range first, primary finding, drill-down table or chart
directions.typography: Tabular numerals, compact labels and readable units
directions.color: Data meaning takes priority over aesthetic color
directions.imagery: Truthful charts using actual units and denominators
directions.motion: Responsive state changes without hiding loading/stale indicators
avoid: dense desktop chart squeezed to mobile

directions.title: Human community
directions.signature: Let identity, real conversations and creation carry the visual voice.
directions.composition: People-and-content-first feed with purposeful creation and moderation access
directions.typography: Clear content hierarchy, strong author context and accessible comments
directions.imagery: Real user media with truthful placeholders and crop rules
directions.motion: Predictable interaction feedback and safe interruption recovery

directions.title: World-embedded interface
directions.signature: Let game-world materials and lore shape framing without obscuring critical information.
directions.composition: Gameplay canvas dominant, diegetic status motifs, explicit pause and result overlays
directions.typography: Thematic display voice paired with highly legible numeric HUD
directions.color: Materials drawn from the game's original art direction with contrast guards
directions.imagery: Original world assets, crafted icon family and state cues
directions.motion: World-consistent transitions with fast combat feedback

directions.title: Arcade signal
directions.signature: Make action, collision, score and retry unmistakable at full game speed.
directions.composition: Wide play area, peripheral glanceable HUD and decisive round-end screen
directions.typography: Hard-working numerals with strong score and timer hierarchy
directions.color: High-salience gameplay cues using redundant shape and motion signals
directions.imagery: Original high-contrast silhouettes, spare functional VFX
directions.motion: Instant input response and controlled celebration, no critical feedback delay

directions.title: Cozy tactile
directions.signature: Build a coherent handcrafted material language and unhurried progress clarity.
directions.composition: Environment-first play surface, thumb-friendly contextual tools, clear inventory loops
directions.typography: Warm display type with neutral readable labels
directions.color: Soft art-driven palette reinforced by contrast-safe text surfaces
directions.imagery: Original props, tactile feedback, coherent illustrations
directions.motion: Gentle transitions that never block skip or input

directions.title: Readable tactics
directions.signature: Make spatial decisions and turn consequences visible before decoration.
directions.composition: Large navigable map, contextual actionable information, restrained turn log
directions.typography: Compact legible tactical labels with clear risk/warning cues
directions.color: Separate selection, danger and ownership by color plus shape
directions.imagery: Controlled sprites/meshes with readable silhouette and tile hierarchy
directions.motion: Intentional preview, unambiguous turn transition and accessible motion options
avoid: combat info hidden in hover alone

directions.title: Systems-forward premium
directions.signature: Express depth through authored icons, resilient HUD and meaningful reward presentation.
directions.composition: Clear play canvas, selective system HUD, reward and progression as distinct layers
directions.typography: Consistent numeric hierarchy and localizable copy widths
directions.color: Game identity palette with scarce emphasis and semantic rarity/status
directions.motion: Purposeful reward beats and low-cost, opt-out effects
